agent.memory.title: Render memory startup hook configuration
agent.memory.summary: Print SessionStart hook JSON for a named or detected adapter using the installed companion. Replace earlier Forge memory entries and preserve unrelated settings and hooks; Forge never edits them. Adapters without a startup hook point to the underlying harness.

agent.wait.title: Render PR wait or cleanup steps
agent.wait.summary: Run `forge agent wait <n>` after the PR opens and after each push; do each step, then follow `then`. `--sweep` on session resume; `--done` at land, abandon or handback.

agent.guard.title: Render done-claim and command guard hooks
agent.guard.summary: Print mergeable Stop and PreToolUse hooks using the installed package companions. Name an adapter or detect exactly one harness. Install the printed entries yourself, preserving existing settings and hooks.

route.get.title: Get a role's agent route
route.get.summary: Use the current model at high effort and standard speed. A matched adapter loses to any matched adapter whose over list names it. Detect the sole remaining adapter, inheriting omitted fields from the first matched adapter in its over list; otherwise use current. Max requires ~/.forge/routing.yaml.
